# Vendor & budget tracker

- **[budget-timeline.html](budget-timeline.html)** — open in any browser. Overview stats, filterable vendor cards, a payment/deadline timeline, and a to-do list, all in one static page (no build step, no server).
- **[vendors.md](vendors.md)** — the same data as readable prose, with more context/quotes from the source emails.
- **[TODOS.md](TODOS.md)** — plain-text checklist version of the to-dos in the tracker.

All three were generated 2026-09-07 by scraping wedding-related threads out of the `bellabenbao@gmail.com` inbox (contracts, deposit invoices, receipts, quotes). Treat the numbers as a starting point, not ground truth — several vendors' full costs were never spelled out in an email and are marked **TBD**; see the to-do list.
